input.summary: Add exclusive New York County venue to the New York governing law clause
input.comment: [Playbook] New York law is our preferred position and is unchanged; we have simply added exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County so the forum is certain and no arbitration can be implied.

ops.oldText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
ops.newText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws. Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York for all disputes arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment right for the Company and consent control over HDI assignments
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 is silent on consent, which would let HDI assign the hosting of our branded Site to anyone, including a competitor. We have confirmed our right to assign to affiliates and successors and required our consent (not unreasonably withheld) for HDI assignments, with no competitor assignment and no change-of-control right against us.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or business, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the Company's prior written consent (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company.
